costDefaults.label: Beverage, food & paper cost

benchmarkBand.source: Specialty Coffee Association operating benchmark survey — beans, dairy, pastry wholesale and cups together

costDefaults.sourceNote: Espresso pulls cheap; milk, alternative milks, wholesale pastry and the cup itself are what carry this line. Drink-heavy mix runs the low end, food-heavy the high.

costDefaults.label: Baristas
costDefaults.sourceNote: One block ≈ 1.5 barista FTEs at $16/hr plus tips-topped shifts covering open-to-close; ~100 drinks per barista-day through a two-group machine.

costDefaults.label: Shift lead / manager
costDefaults.sourceNote: Working manager at $40k/yr; opens, orders, schedules — required at any volume.

costDefaults.label: Rent

benchmarkBand.source: IBISWorld 72251 — quarterly rent for 1,000-1,800 sq ft of foot-traffic retail

costDefaults.sourceNote: 1,400 sq ft at $40/sq ft/yr NNN on a walkable corridor. A coffee shop lives or dies on the corner it rents.
